attributes.description:
Fan Sphere brings sports fans together around the teams and games they care about. Find watch parties, join fan groups, browse game schedules and share short videos with your community.

HOME
• See games, nearby watch parties and your fan groups in one place
• Follow the sports and teams you care about

DISCOVER
• Find fan groups, watch parties and venues
• Meet fans who share your interests

GAME DAY
• Browse game schedules across football, basketball, baseball, soccer, college sports and more
• Live, upcoming and final states as the day unfolds

CLIPS
• Record and share your own game-day videos
• Watch what your community is posting
• Upload content you own or have permission to share

FAN GROUPS AND WATCH PARTIES
• Public watch parties — RSVP and join fellow fans for any game
• Private watch parties — invite your crew, no strangers
• Live chat inside every group and party

OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTIONS
Fan Sphere is free to use. Public watch parties, joining fan groups, RSVPing and watching clips need no paid plan.

Home Team adds unlimited clip posting, private invite-only watch parties, the full RSVP guest list and a fan badge. US $4.99 per month or US $34.99 per year, with a 7-day free trial where eligible.

MVP includes everything in Home Team plus audience analytics, a verified creator badge and featured placement in Discover. US $14.99 per month or US $99.99 per year.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or after any applicable free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings. Prices vary by region; your local price and any eligible trial terms are shown before purchase.

Fan Sphere is an independent fan community app.

Privacy Policy: https://fansphere.org/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Service Terms: https://fansphere.org/terms/
Support: support@thabtech.com
attributes.promotionalText: Find public watch parties, join fan groups and share your own game-day videos. Home Team adds private watch parties for your crew.
